case.summary: Transaction 3509359 ($125.08, online) on card C12265-K2 was flagged by a legacy risk score of 0.52, but the calibrated fraud model evaluated it at 0.006 with an empirical fraud rate of only 0.6%. The transaction was conducted via a generic desktop device profile with no fraud ring associations and two prior cleared cases. Although the card experienced account takeover compromises three months earlier, those incidents preceded card reissuance under a different holder anchor day, and the current holder identity has no confirmed fraud history. Regular in-person spending in the cardholder's home billing region continued without disruption before and after the purchase, with no card testing or dispute reported. The alert was determined to be a false alarm and the transaction was cleared as legitimate.
